name: retopology_display
description: Retopology display mode: how the edited (foreground) items are drawn over background layers. Measured on the reference editor through numeric commands and framebuffer reads; its own identifiers stay in the private toolcard. Colours are 0..1 palette values; pixel cells are 8-bit framebuffer reads, front orthographic view, empty viewport (92,102,107).

provenance.harness: isolated GUI session, numeric commands, framebuffer reads
provenance.notes: Base record from task 8550; the follow-up cells (order, facing, picking, same-as-active backdrop, dots by selection mode, selection placement) from task 8551, same date and harness. The picking cell drove four clicks on a vertex behind the item's own face plus an unoccluded control click. Identifiers stay in the private toolcard.

depth.law: depth buffer cleared before each foreground item; depth test and write stay on within the item; no occlusion between foreground items
rival_refuted: depth test off (an item's own face hides its own edge)
depth offset (an item 29.5 units behind the background stays fully visible)
depth.views: holds in two rotated orthographic views and in perspective

face.light: the same light function as the background surface

edge.shade_rule: light at the item's local +Z: the colour a polygon of the same item facing its local +Z would have, with the edge palette in place of the face palette; independent of the polygon the edge belongs to; changes with the view because the reference's light is camera-attached

vertex.shade_rule: as edge.shade_rule, with the vertex palette
vertex.cull_rule: hidden iff every incident polygon faces away and at least one has >= 3 vertices; isolated vertices drawn; a selected vertex is never culled
vertex.gate: base dots drawn iff the cell shows vertices; the selection mode changes neither the gate, the colour nor the size

light_gain.applies_to: everything above ambient; ambient unscaled; background surfaces too
light_gain.specular: INFERRED, not measured: the fit cannot separate a specular term; ours scales it with diffuse

light_rig: camera-attached at the reference (a fixed tile's value changes with the view)

selection.placement: the primary item's selection passes run AFTER the whole item sequence, depth-tested against what it left, with the occluded pass, no depth clear

cells.what: selected vertex behind a later-drawn background surface
selected vertex behind the item's own fill

backdrop.wireframe_writes_slot: see backdrop_display_slots.json (frozen); cross-checked by the retopology capture, agrees

order_between_items: reverse layer order, independent of which item is primary
within_item_polygon_order: one depth-writing fill pass in reverse polygon index order (a depth pre-pass is refuted)
back_face_depth: a back-facing polygon writes no depth (culled from the whole face pass)
picking_under_mode: occlusion follows the active style regardless of the mode (shaded: the vertex behind the item's own face is not picked; wireframe: it is)
picking_control: a click on an unoccluded vertex of the same item picks it
backdrop_under_mode_same_as_active: drawn in the active style with the light gain, not dimmed, as ordinary items inside the reverse-layer item sequence with no depth clear of their own
facing_in_perspective: per eye (screen winding) for both the fill and the dots
dots_by_selection_mode: base dots follow show-vertices only; pixel-identical in vertex, edge and polygon selection modes
